t: An open hardware software defined radio that tunes from 1 MHz to 6 GHz.
steps: Find a HackRF One at a shop such as Lab401 or RoboSavvy, or choose the newer HackRF Pro.
Buy an antenna for the band you want, as none comes in the box.
Install the HackRF host tools and libhackrf from the official docs.
Plug it in with the micro USB cable and confirm the computer sees it.
Open an SDR app such as SDR# or GNU Radio.
Tune to a local FM station as your first listen.
Keep to receive only unless you hold a license for the band.
meta: Wild Open. From $330. A few stores.
